The Big Question

I really really love you will u be my gf?

There are only two buttons. One of them is a coward.

 
💜

You said yes!

Every no just made this yes even sweeter.

YES! 💜

Now for the part I've been looking forward to. 💌

💌

My Girl, you are one of the most beautiful parts of my life.

Your smile brightens my darkest days, and your presence makes everything feel complete. There's a kind of calm I only feel when I'm with you, like whatever else is going on, this part is right.

I don't say it enough, but I notice all of it — the way you laugh at your own jokes before you even finish them, the way you take care of everyone around you without ever asking for anything back, the way you make ordinary days feel like they matter. Being loved by you has made me softer and braver at the same time, and I don't think I'll ever stop being grateful for that.

Thank you for being you. No matter what happens, you'll always have a special place in my heart. I hope your days are filled with happiness, love, and endless reasons to smile, and I hope I get to be the reason for a few of them.

Here's to every silly fight, every inside joke, every quiet night in and loud night out still ahead of us. Forever yours. 💜

Always yours,
💜

made with way too much love, for you 💜
